subject: Sarah's 3AM spiral that changed 600 lives
preview_text: How one user's darkest moment became a breakthrough for thousands — and might be yours too.
body_paragraphs: Sarah was 42 days into no-contact when she found herself sobbing at 3AM, phone in hand, about to text her ex. Instead, she opened Fresh Start and hit emergency mode — and what happened next made our entire team stop and read. Her raw journal entry that night became the most-shared story in our community, and it might be exactly what you need to hear right now.

She wrote, 'I thought I was broken. But the AI didn't judge me. It just said, 'Tell me about the version of you that existed before him.' That question cracked something open. I realized I'd forgotten who I was.' Within a week, her mood tracking showed a 30% improvement — not because she was suddenly fine, but because she was finally honest about the mess. Sarah is now 180 days into her journey, and she credits that 3AM moment as the turning point.

This is why we built the emergency mode — not as a gimmick, but as a lifeline for those 2AM and 3AM spirals. It's one tap away, gives you personalized coping strategies based on your breakup type, and connects you to a community of people who get it. Over 600 users have used it, and our data shows it cuts spiral duration by 40% on average.

Open Fresh Start: Breakup Therapy and check your mood tracking — see if you've had a 'Sarah moment' yet. You're closer to your turning point than you think. P.S. Sarah's full story is in the app under 'Community Stories' — it'll make you cry, then smile.
